chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from an-Nadr from Yahya al-Halabi from Imran ibn Ali said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the Adhan before Fajr, and he said: 'If it is in congregation, there is no [Adhan]; and if it is alone, there is no harm [in doing so].'
ai.seo_question: What is the Shia ruling on calling the Adhan before the Fajr prayer, and does it differ between individual and congregational settings?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the juristic distinction between communal and individual recitation of the pre-dawn Adhan, reflecting the practical flexibility in Shia fiqh regarding ritual announcements. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) indicates that while congregational Adhan before Fajr is not practiced (likely to avoid confusion with the Iqamah or to preserve the distinct status of the Fajr call), individual recitation is permissible, highlighting the importance of context in ritual observance.
